text: {"hierarchy": 4, "layout_spacing": 2, "typography": 3, "color_contrast": 4, "consistency": 3, "overall": 3, "reason": "The certificate has an elegant gold-and-cream palette and decorative border, but overlapping text (\"OF CONTRIBUTION\" over \"CERTIFICATE\", the signature over \"PRESENTED TO\"), text running off the frame edges, and cramped footer elements severely undermine legibility and layout quality."}
